0022600114.text: The Orlando Magic (0-2, 13th in the East and 4th in the Southeast, 1.5 games back) visit the New York Knicks (0-2, 11th in the East and 4th in the Atlantic, 2.5 games back) in the third game of the Magic's season, with both teams still seeking their first win and Orlando on a two-game losing streak. Orlando is without Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain; 24.5 points per game this season), Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), Jonathan Isaac (knee), and Noah Penda (hamstring strain), while Anthony Black is day-to-day with an ankle sprain and a game-time decision, and New York's Jose Alvarado is also day-to-day with an ankle sprain and a game-time decision. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the 2025-26 season series was split 2-2, with the most recent meeting on December 13, 2025, in Orlando, where the Magic lost 132-120.
